[size=4]Welcome to [b]YuVei's Weebtoon Pixel Portraits[/b]! This mod is a complete reimaging of the Stardew Valley characters, blending the style of modern Manhwa (Korean Webtoons) with classic Anime pixel art.[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FrIbJeC.gif[/img]﻿


[img]https://i.imgur.com/JhDDpZ3.png[/img]﻿[b]
[/b][size=4]
This is a Milestone Project! I am committed to overhauling the entire game's cast, but I need your support to know people want this content [b][i]by simply download or endorse this mod.[/i][/b][/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bEQAGMM.png[/img]

[/font][size=4][b]Q: Is this compatible with other mods?[/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[/font]A: It should be compatible with any mod that doesn't also replace portrait files.

[b]Q: Will the portraits change back to the original (Vanilla) art during Winter?
[/b]A: No. I want to keep the art style consistent throughout your game. If a character doesn't have a seasonal outfit finished yet, they will use my custom [b]Standard (Spring)[/b] portrait instead of switching back to the game's original art.[/size]
